title: Uber

highlights.title: Corporate Billing Integration

highlights.detail: Architected store-level performance intelligence with click-through rate (CTR), click-to-order rate (CTO), online uptime, and competitor benchmarks, enabling 62% of ad accounts to take guided campaign optimizations.

title: Elevate K-12
